## Background
Texas suffered three severe winter storms in 2021 on February 10-11, 13-17, and 15-20.

In this assignment, we evaluate impacts of the winter storms by estimating the number of homes and areas in the Houston metropolitan area that lost power. We use remotely-sensed night lights data from the Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) on the Suomi satellite. We use building and roads data from OpenStreetMap.

We have two datasets from VIIRS, one before the storm (Feb 7) and one after (Feb 16).

## Read in data

```{r}
#| output: False
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
library(raster)
```

```{r}
filelist <- list.files(here::here("data", "VNP46A1"), full.names = TRUE)
h08v05_feb7 <- rast(filelist[1])
h08v06_feb7 <- rast(filelist[2])
h08v05_feb16 <- rast(filelist[3])
h08v06_feb16 <- rast(filelist[4])

roads <- read_sf('data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg')
houses <- read_sf('data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg')
```

## Find locations that experienced a blackout

### Merge tiles for 2021-02-07 and 2021-02-16

```{r}
# Check CRS match
same.crs(h08v05_feb7,h08v06_feb7)
same.crs(h08v05_feb16,h08v06_feb16)
```

```{r}
viirs_feb7 <- merge(h08v05_feb7,h08v06_feb7)
viirs_feb16 <- merge(h08v05_feb16,h08v06_feb16)
```

### Create blackout mask

Find change in night light intensity

```{r}
dlights <- viirs_feb7 - viirs_feb16
```

Reclassify the difference raster.\
Assign `NA` to locations with a drop of less than 200 change

```{r}
# Reclassify matrix
rcl <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, -200, 1,
    -200, 200, NA,
    200, Inf, 1
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply reclassification
blackout_zones <- as.factor(classify(dlights, rcl = rcl))
```

Vectorize the blackout mask.

```{r}
blackout_mask <- as.polygons(blackout_zones) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    rename(zone = 1)
```

Crop the blackout mask to houston area

```{r}
# Create bounding box for Houston
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, xmax = -94.5, ymin = 29, ymax = 30.5),
                        crs = st_crs(blackout_mask)) |> 
                    st_as_sfc()
# Crop blackout mask to Houston
blackout_houston <- st_crop(blackout_mask, houston_bbox)
```

Reproject the blackout data to EPSG:3083

```{r}
blackout_houston <- st_transform(blackout_houston, 3083)

# Check CRS
crs(blackout_houston)
```

### Exclude highways from the cropped blackout mask

Highway changes in night light intensities are less likely to be related to the storm. We will remove the highway from the blackout mask.

Identify areas within 200m of all highways.

```{r}
roads <- st_transform(roads, 3083)

blackout_highways <- st_join(blackout_houston, roads, 
                             st_is_within_distance, 
                             dist = units::set_units(200,'m'))
```

Find areas that experienced blackouts further than 200m from a highway

```{r}
# crop out the highways and the 200m within
blackout_mask_cropped <- st_crop(blackout_houston, blackout_highways, inverse = TRUE)
```

### Identify the number of homes likely impacted by blackouts

```{r}
houses <- st_transform(houses, 3083)

blackout_homes <- st_crop(houses, blackout_mask_cropped)
```

Visualize the homes

```{r}
tm_basemap(server = "Esri.WorldTopoMap") + 
tm_shape(blackout_homes) +
    tm_polygons()
```
